description: This PHP source file defines the AccessEmployeeFileController class, which handles HTTP requests to access employee data files in JSON format within the OrangeHRM Maintenance plugin. It includes methods for retrieving download formats and maintenance services, and processes requests while checking user permissions.

classes.name: AccessEmployeeFileController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling JSON data download requests for employee information, with permission checks and proper response formatting.

methods.name: getDownloadFormat
methods.description: Returns an instance of JsonDownloadFormat, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getMaintenanceService
methods.description: Returns an instance of MaintenanceService, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the incoming request for employee data, checks permissions, and prepares a JSON response with employee information or handles bad requests.
